Class ServerEndpointExporter

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.context.support.ApplicationObjectSupport
org.springframework.web.context.support.WebApplicationObjectSupport
org.springframework.web.socket.server.standard.ServerEndpointExporter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, InitializingBean, SmartInitializingSingleton, ApplicationContextAware, ServletContextAware
public class ServerEndpointExporter extends WebApplicationObjectSupport implements InitializingBean, SmartInitializingSingleton
Detects beans of type ServerEndpointConfig and registers with the standard Jakarta WebSocket runtime. Also detects beans annotated with ServerEndpoint and registers them as well. Although not required, it is likely annotated endpoints should have their configurator property set to SpringConfigurator.

当通过 Spring 配置声明此类时，应能够关闭 Servlet 容器对 WebSocket 端点的扫描。这可以通过在 `web.xml` 中使用 `<absolute-ordering>` 元素来实现。

Since:
4.0
Author:
Rossen Stoyanchev，Juergen Hoeller

    • afterSingletonsInstantiated

      public void afterSingletonsInstantiated()
      描述从接口复制：SmartInitializingSingleton
      Invoked right at the end of the singleton pre-instantiation phase, with a guarantee that all regular singleton beans have been created already. ListableBeanFactory.getBeansOfType(Class) calls within this method won't trigger accidental side effects during bootstrap.

      注意：此回调不会为在 BeanFactory 引导后按需懒式初始化的单例 Bean 触发，也不会为任何其他 Bean 作用域触发。请仅针对具有预期引导语义的 Bean 谨慎使用它。

      Specified by:
      `afterSingletonsInstantiated` 接口 `SmartInitializingSingleton` 中
